draft.name: create_lead
draft.title: Create Lead
draft.goal: Create a new lead record with contact, account, location, and opportunity details.
steps: On the Leads list page, click '+ Create Lead' in the top-right corner.
On the Leads > create form, enter {{first_name}} in the First Name field under Name.
Enter {{last_name}} in the Last Name field under Name.
Enter {{account_name}} in the Account Name field.
Under Address, enter {{city}} in the City field.
Scroll down to Details and enter {{opportunity_amount}} in the Opportunity Amount field.

params.name: account_name
params.description: Account / company name for the lead

draft.success: The lead detail page opens (Leads > lead's full name) showing the created lead in Overview and Details, including its name, account name, email, title, website, address, and opportunity amount, with Status displayed and a Created timestamp.
